thread:
mike_sales: Heads-up - NeoDynamics POC hitting 403 on server-side calls during integration tests. Demo Friday. Can someone triage?
anya_se: Can you paste the exact request + response from their logs? 403 usually means key scope/allowlist issue.
mike_sales: From their logs:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk_org_trial_xx77
X-Redwood-Org: neodynamics
X-Redwood-Project: nd-testing
Response: {"error":{"code":"forbidden","message":"key does not have access to project"}}
```
ravi_eng: That org key looks like it has a project allowlist on the account. If nd-testing isn't listed it will 403. Two fixes: 1) remove X-Redwood-Project header so org routing picks default project, or 2) expand the allowlist to include nd-testing. Also confirm key scopes include inference:generate.
sarah_support: I checked the console: sk_org_trial_xx77 is restricted to nd-main only. I can temporarily add nd-testing for the demo. Which do you prefer?
mike_sales: Add nd-testing temporarily please. Also can you rotate after demo?
sarah_support: Done 45s ago. Expanded allowlist for sk_org_trial_xx77 for 90 minutes and scheduled rotation after the call. Audit id: audit-20260314-42.
bot-help: Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/auth#org-keys-allowlist (includes example header combos)
anya_se: Ask them to retry with a raw curl to verify. Sample:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_org_trial_xx77" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Org: neodynamics" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
mike_sales: They retried and now get 200. Demo on track. s/support please add a one-liner to trial playbook about org-key allowlists + SDKs auto-attaching project header.
sarah_support: Adding KB note now and will rotate the key after demo. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
